mapper.select: SELECT g.id as goodsId, g.name as goodsName, t.name as typeName, g.price, COALESCE(SUM(oi.amount), 0) as salesCount FROM goods g LEFT JOIN type t ON g.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN orderitem oi ON g.id = oi.goods_id LEFT JOIN `order` o ON oi.order_id = o.id AND o.status = 3 WHERE g.stock > 0 GROUP BY g.id, g.name, t.name, g.price ORDER BY salesCount DESC
